title: One Spoon of This Outweighs Every Human on Earth
description:
A neutron star packs more mass than our Sun into a ball about the size of a city. A teaspoon of it would weigh around a billion tonnes on Earth.

Here is how something can get that dense.

#space #science #astronomy

scenes.narration: One teaspoon of this weighs about a billion tonnes. More than every human on Earth put together.
It is a neutron star, what is left after a giant star explodes.
Gravity crushes the core so hard that atoms collapse. Electrons and protons are squeezed together into neutrons.
The result packs more mass than our Sun into a ball only about twenty kilometers wide. Roughly the size of a city.
Some spin hundreds of times every second, sweeping beams of radiation across space like a lighthouse.
So the heaviest spoonful in the universe is not made of gold. It is made of a dead star.
